readerCopy.body: A founder becomes a screen for the crowd's expectations. Supporters read rescue, healing, creativity, or moral certainty into every appearance while ordinary limits disappear from the conversation. The Sun holds the public identity, while Neptune surrounds that identity with longing, projection, and an idealized story. Under the conjunction, the person and the dream become almost impossible for the audience to separate. The devotion may be sincere, but one human mistake can feel like betrayal to people who expected proof that the dream was real.
